written: 2026-09-25 00:15 UTC, before any strategy return was computed (only data loading, OKX listing calendar and OKX cost snapshot done)
direction: Long-tail cross-sectional market-neutral perps: PIT OKX-listed ranks 31-150 by trailing-30d Binance quote volume; top-30 as comparison

universe.rank: daily; trailing 30-day mean Binance USDT-M quote volume (min 7 days), data up to D-1; eligible if >=14 days of Binance history and OKX-listed on D-1 (static.okx.com per-instrument daily trade archive calendar, Hermes OkxListing); stable/index/tradfi excluded

signals.age: log days since first Binance trading day
signals.rr1d: -(1d log return - beta*market 1d log return), beta on 720h hourly returns vs equal-weight panel market
signals.sign: per (signal, universe, R): sign of the IS mean cross-sectional Spearman IC with the next-R-hour log return

portfolio.decision_times: UTC multiples of R, at bar close
portfolio.legs: long top 25% / short bottom 25% of the eligible universe by score
portfolio.weights: inverse 7-day hourly vol within each leg (vol floored at the cross-sectional 20th pct), cap 2x equal weight, each leg 0.5 of gross
neutral: beta (legs rescaled so sum w*beta = 0, gross kept 1; betas clipped to [0.2,3])
hysteresis: on: a held name stays while its percentile stays within the top/bottom 50%

combos.COMBOk: equal-weight average of signed percentile ranks of the k best single signals by IS net Sharpe at the same (universe, R, neutral, hysteresis); k in {2,3,5}
combos.LGBM: LightGBM regressor, fixed params (num_leaves 15, lr 0.05, 300 trees, min_data_in_leaf 1000, feature_fraction 0.8, bagging 0.8), features = 12 signals as cross-sectional percentiles + log ADV pct + vol pct; target = cross-sectional percentile of next-R-hour log return; expanding window, retrained monthly, purge R hours; first prediction 2022-07-01 (IS Sharpe measured 2022-07..2024-12)

execution_costs.base: trade at decision bar close (Binance 1h close), OKX VIP0 taker fee 5 bp/side + slippage vs mid
execution_costs.slippage: max(floor, exp(6.745 - 0.438 ln ADV30_binance + 0.317 ln order_USDT)) bp; fitted on OKX order books 2026-09-25 (283 swaps, 50..10000 USDT market orders); floor 1 bp TOP30, 3 bp TAIL
execution_costs.funding: Binance funding rates (OKX archive ends 2025-09-07; checked separately)
execution_costs.stress: costs x1.5 and one extra 1h bar of latency
execution_costs.account: 5,000 USDT; OKX ctVal/lotSz/minSz (current instruments, price-scaled); names absent from OKX today assume 1 USDT lots

selection: per universe, the configuration with highest IS net Sharpe (1x) over the whole grid (singles, combos, LGBM); OOS evaluated after selection

success_bar.1: OOS 2025-01-01..2026-08-31 net Sharpe >= 1.5 at 1x, 2025 and 2026(Jan-Aug) both positive
success_bar.2: LOMO and LOCO OOS Sharpe >= 1.0; costs x1.5 + 1 bar latency OOS Sharpe >= 0.8
success_bar.3: executable by 1k-10k USDT on OKX (listing, lots, VIP0 fees, slippage)
success_bar.4: largest L in {1,2,3,5,8,10,15,20} with OOS intrabar MDD <= 35% and no liquidation (OKX tiers, intrabar extremes) and L <= IS half-Kelly
